svg.title: Jaykishan Das, Full Stack Web Developer
svg.desc: Jaykishan Das is a Full Stack Web Developer at Vexora Technology. Animated hero: a camera viewfinder plays a short clip of the developer, beside a typed greeting, a gradient name, rotating role lines and the skills he works with, each with its logo.

g.text: I turn random ideas into full-stack apps, AI tools and desktop software.
